tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma rin po che'i rnam par thar pa'o// karma pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// "$

dha ma 'aghu ru na mo/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la// longs sku khri gdugs nyi ma shar// sprul sku'i char rgyun kun la khyab// 'gro mgon bla ma rin po che'i zhabs la 'dud// bla ma rin po che'i rnam thar dang dag snang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'dir mdo tsam gcig bkod pa las/ sku skye ba 'di yi rnam thar dang dag snang ni/ lo bdun brgyad la yi ge mkhas pa'i tshad du phyin pa yin gsungs/ de'i dus nas dag snang yang 'ga' re byung ste ngo ma shes gsungs/ de nas dbus la 'gro snyam nas 'ongs pa'i dus su/ rin po che spong rag pa sha 'bom na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ mchod cung khyod gang nas 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ nged sa stod nas 'ongs pa yin da dbus su 'gro byas pa'i dus su/ khyod nga'i gdul bya gcig e ma yin bas gar ma 'gro gsungs/ de'i nub mo shes rab blo gros pas dbang bskur zhus pa'i gral du khrid nas/ shin tu thugs la btags par byung gsungs/ dbang bskur tshar ba'i dus rjes mi med pa'i dus su/ do nub khyod 'dug pa'i thad so na/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dang bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams gsal bas/ khyod las can gcig e ma yin gsungs/ de nas se ko dgon na 'ongs pa'i dus su/ sel ko zhe ko gnyis kyi bar sgang na/ she mur 'go'i sgang 'gul na phyin ba'i dus su/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ di ring de dus gsum mkhyen pa'i snang bas nam mkha' gang ba gcig byung gsungs/ khyod skal ldan gcig yin bar 'dug pas/ gar yang ma 'gro sdod la nga'i chos 'di tsho nyams su long gsungs/ rin po che pas mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' bar 'dug ste/ gsang ba yin par snang*/ de phyis chad pha dang bu phrad pa bzhin du song*/ sems ngo yang skad gcig gis shes par byung gsungs/ tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin bar 'dug /gar yang mi 'gro bsdad dgos snyams nas chos thams cad nyams su blangs/ ci gsung bka' bzhin du bsgrubs/

bsgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas/ dag snang yang bsam kyis mi khyab pa byung*/ bla ma yang shin tu mos par byung gsungs/ de nas gnas nang na phyin pa'i dus su/ gzhal yas khang 'ja' tshon 'dra ba'i nang nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang rje dus gsum mkhyen pa bzhugs pa gcig 'dug /dge bsnyen kyis rin po che'i khri chen po gcig brtsigs pa la/ khyed 'di na bzhugs zer zhing 'dug gdan sa gsar rnying zug pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ gnas nang 'phar slang na bsgoms pa'i dus su/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad gsal ba las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i snang ba zhag gsum du byung gsungs/ de nas sbungs ri na 'ongs pa'i dus su/ gnas nang lung pa'i g.yas g.yon thams cad la/ g.yas phyogs thams cad dpa' bo yi dkyil 'khor/ g.yon phyogs thams cad dpa' mo'i dkyil 'khor/ de rnams kyis gar khyug khyug byed cing skyel ba 'dra ba gcig byung gsungs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dpag tu med pa'i zhal nas dag snang mkha' spyod 'di yin gsungs/ yang nyi ma phyi dro gcig la dpal lha mos ya thod nam mkha' byas/ ma thod sa byas pa tsam du zhal gdangs nas/ byang phyogs na mar la nag mo 'bum de dang bcas pa rngam nas thal ba gcig byung gsungs/ de'i don ci lags zhus pas/ stod na tshur la hor 'ong ba zlogs pa'i brda e ma yin gsung*/ yang sgo rig bdun pa yon btsun tshul rgyal yi pha bsnyos pa'i dus su/ gdan drangs nas gtor dbang zhus pa'i dus su/ gtor dbang bdun gyis sol bar bya snyam tsa/ sgo rigs mi nag bon po 'jings che bas/ yon btsun la bon pos/ ban dhe be gar yin bas be gar spyi thul zer ba/ khos spya ngar zhus nas/ de sngon gtor dbang gsum byas pas yang ma phan/ bon pos kyang de zer byas pa'i dus su/ thugs 'khrugs nas chos skyong la gsol ba drag tu btabs pa las/ nga bdag kyang khrugs kyis song nas 'jig rten gyi khams khar btabs kyang kha gang ba'i snang ba ma byung nas/

gtor ma mi bzhis mi khyag pa gcig te phyag gis blangs nas thang la brgyabs pa'i dus su/ de'i dus su steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas chos skyong gis gang ba cig byung gsungs/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu mgon po'i bstod pa yang mdzad pa yin gsungs/ ru rong na yar 'ongs pa'i dus su/ sgo rigs kyi sa bdag rnams bsu ba la byung ba dang*/ dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'thab ci 'dug pa las/ ngas khong rnams la ma 'thab byas gtor ma phul/ de'i dus su dge bsnyen kyi zhal nas/ da res khyed rnams rgyal ba gyis dang*/ lo 'ga' tsa nga yis gdan drangs bas chog zer zhing 'dug /na ning 'phyis gnas nang du bstan pa dar rgyas pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs/ gnas nang rgyal mo mtsho 'gram du chos khri brtsigs/ gzhi bdag la yul dang sa gzhi yang bslangs pa las/ bu 'bor sgang gi lha 'dre yod tshad dbang du bsdus nas bka' bsgo byas pa'i dus su// gzhan snang du yang ri snyil ba dang gangs 'drogs pa dang*/ skad sna tshogs sgrogs pa dang thang shing rnams rlung thog gis bsgyel ba dang*/ rkya mi dmag tshogs mang po mthong bar 'dug /dge bsnyen dang gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal nas/ phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du khyed kyi bu slobs dang bstan pa nged kyi bskyang ba yin/ mdo la yan chad khyed kyi gdan sa gyis/ mdo la phyin chad nged kyi yin/ ma trong la ring phyin chad la ma reg zer ba byung*/ yang gnas nang nas sa stod la 'ongs pa'i dus su/ dge bsnyen gyis dar dkar po'i na bza' gcig phul nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstan pa khyed kyis srungs zer ba gcig byung*/ lam na grib dang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang tsha yul cong brag la song ba'i dus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs grangs med pas bskor zhing*/

gzhi bdag rnams kyis rang cag la 'bul ba byed pa gcig byung*/ gzhan snang du yang sprin shel gyi kha dog 'dra ba dang*/ gur phubs pa 'dra ba dang*/ 'od dang 'ja' dang*/ nyams dga' ba'i ltas mang po 'dug /rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i gangs ri de/ ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa rnams kyi gzhal yas khang dang pho brang yin bar 'dug /rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i lam yig gcig kyang yod/ 'phrin las sna tshogs grub pa'i gnas yin gsungs/ de nas kar ma na byon pa'i dus su/ 'gro mgon yab sras bka' brgyud kun bzhugs sa yin pa la/ dha ki ma mang pos bskor ba byed pa cig zhal gzigs gsungs/ de'i don ni da rung bstan pa dar rgyas yod pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang kar ma na dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ring srel mang po yod snyams byed/ sgom chen mang po 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de nas kar ma nas mtshur phu na yar 'ong ba la/ sngags bdag gis nor bu rin po che byin pa 'dra ba gcig byung*/ bsam pa thams cad grub pa'i brda yin pa 'dra gsungs/ yang dpal lha mo nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa byon nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdan sa 'jigs la khad/ dbus su myur du la ma 'gro dgos zer ba'i gcig byung gsungs/ yang kar ma nas mtshur phu la 'ong ba'i dus su/ 'jig rten gyi khams gsal ba gcig byung gsungs/ de min yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa gsal ba gcig byung*/ de rnams thams cad rlungs sems kyi 'dus tshul yin par snang gsung*/ kho bo yang tshe ring bar 'dug snyam pa cig byung gsungs/ de nas byang lam na yar 'ongs pa'i dus su/ lam nor ba yang min ste bstan pa'i che ba 'don pa'i phyir/ mgon po la drag tu bos pa'i tshe/ mgon po lha dmag dang bcas pa sngon la phar thal ba dang*/ sra 'gying ba'i gzhi bdag rnams skrags nas bros pa 'dra ba gcig gsungs/ tshangs ldan zhag pa'i dus su/ mang rje tshang gis sku tshad pa la/

'jig rten gyi mgon po rnams kyis rkun ma rnams kyi glo snying 'dren pa gcig byung*/ gangs kar zhol na phyin ba'i dus su/ dbus gtsang gi lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pa'i dus su/ lha 'dre rnams kyis cho 'phrul drag tu bstan cing 'brug sgra chen pos sa gzhi 'gul ba tsam dang*/ thog dang ser ba mang du phab pa gcig byung*/ de ni dbus gtsang na bstan pa dar ba'i brdar 'dug gsung*/ 'bri gung na yar phyin ba'i dus su/ rten 'brel dbang gi che ba bton pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dha ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor nas/ 'bri gung gi gling rangs pa khyab cing gar khyug khyug byed pa cig byung*/ ding sang yang 'bri gung thel pa byams pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ de nas skyi shod la phyir 'ongs pa'i dus su/ jo bo la 'od zer dang bcas pa mang po 'dug snyam pa gcig byung*/ jo bo'i 'phrin las kyi lhag ma yod pa 'dra gsungs/ lha sa na yar byon pa'i dus su/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa la 'od zer gyi rang bzhin gcig bzhengs nas snang ba la/ 'od zer mang po byung nas bdag la thib pa snyams byed pa gcig byung gsungs/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de nas mtshur phur phyin pa'i dus su/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skus steng 'og phyogs 'tshams na grangs med pa gcig snang ba byung*/ de'i don ni dbus gtsang thams cad na/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang tshes bcu'i tho rangs kha gcig dwags po'i phyogs nas/ bla ma lha rje ri tsam pa gcig yod snyams byed pa las/ 'od zer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba gcig byung nas/ rang la thim pa gcig byung*/ de'i don ni bsgrubs rgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang nya se'i tshes bco lnga'i dus su/ bram ze chen po la grub thob thams cad kyis bskor nas nam mkha' gang ba thams cad kyi zhal nas/

skye ba med pa'i sgra phyogs med du grag pa gcig thos de'i don ni mchog gi dngos grub thob pa mang po 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang lha sar jo bo la gser gsol du phyin ba'i dus su/ rta mgrin dbu stong spyan stong pa gcig la/ slob dpon pad ma grangs med pas bskor zhing*/ 'od zer nyi 'od ltar grangs med pa spros pa gcig gzigs/ de ni snang srid dbang du bsdu ba dang zil gyis gnon ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang bkra shis 'od 'bar ca ra nas gdan drangs pa'i dus su/ 'khor lo bde mchog kun tu zhal kha dog sna tshogs pa/ zhal phyag grangs med pa phyogs bzhi na rje btsun ma kha dog rnam pa bzhi dang ldan pa dang zhal sbyor du yod pa/ mdun rgyab med pa gcig la/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros nam mkha' gang nas 'dug pa'i gtso bo'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' gang ba'i bde mchog ni// gang nas bltas kyang sgrib pa med// chos dbyings rabs 'byams dri med ma lus pa// 'khor lo bde mchog dkyil 'khor yin gsung ba gcig byung gsungs/ yang rje btsun mi la'i gsol zhal la gsol ba btab nas/ rten rnams rab gnas byas pa'i dus su/ rje btsun mi la ras dkar bo'i na bza' mnabs pa gcig las/ dha ki ma grangs med pas bskor ba gcig 'dug gsungs/ nam mkha' yang 'jas gang ba gcig byung*/ 'ja' de rnams mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi 'od du snang gsungs// yang tho rangs kha gcig nam mkha' dang sa gzhi bar snang thams cad 'od zer dmar por song sin nas 'dug /de nas cung zhig lon pa dang*/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gsal ba nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba gcig bzhugs zin/ thub pa de'i zhal nas theg pa chen po'i chos gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid gang nas ma byung*/ gang du mi 'gro'o ces gsung par 'dug /nam mkha' na mar lha'i bu 'ja' tshon gyi gur nang na 'dug pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams pad ma can zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs pa yang thos/

de nas sangs rgyas de'i 'od kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal bar 'dug /'jig rten kyi khams 'di rnams smig rgyu'i 'ja' tshon bzhin gsal bar byung*/ de nas sangs rgyas de 'ja' yal ba bzhin du yal nas thal/ de phyin chod du 'gro ba lha mi'i sgra dang*/ 'dzam bu gling gi bya byed rnams gsal bar byung gsung*/ yang dben tsa phug gi shing bcad pa'i dus su/ slob dpon pad ma la gsol ba btabs pa la/ rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa gcig gi thugs ka nas/ bya khyung dmar po gshog pa'i 'ur sgra dang khyung gi skad sgrogs pas/ klu srin mang pos rang dbang med par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o zer ba'i sgra sgrogs pa gcig byung*/ slob dpon pad ma la 'khor mi ma yin mang pos bskor ba la/ chos gsungs pa ni yang dang yang du gsal bar byung*/ de'i phyir slob dpon pad ma la gsol ba yang dang yang 'debs pa de yin gsungs/ yang shar phyogs sman lha'i zhing khams yang gsal bar byung gsungs/ de'i nyan thos rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa mdzad pa yang mthong*/ yang nub gcig rgyal po rnam thos sras gser khrab gyon pa lag na mdung dar bzung nas/ 'khor gser khrab can dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ 'brug la zhon pa 'brug gi sgra sgrogs shing 'ong ba gcig byung*/ 'khor rnams kyi rta zhon pa mdung dar thogs par 'dug /nga'i pho brang du 'ong dgos zer ba'i snang ba byung*/ de'i don ni hor yul du 'gro dgos par 'dug gsungs/ yang lo sar yi tshes gsum gyi nub mo rmi lam na/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi la tsa ri la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas mang po gsal bar byung*/ tsa ri'i mkha' 'gro ma'i gtso mo de khros ma nag mor 'dug mkha' 'gro ma bsam kyi mi khyab pas bskor nas 'dug pa yang gsal bar byung gsungs/ mtsho de'i dkyil nas chos 'byung bang dang bcas pa la/

'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba gcig 'dug de shin tu gnyan ba'i brdar snang gsung*/ nyams dga' ba dang bkra shis pa'i ltad mo mang po mthong gsungs/ yang mtshur phu'i bla bye'i chos khri la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ ma mgon dang chos skyong sprin spung bzhin du gtibs nas/ rong po dang dgra rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i dus la bab pa yin na/ mthu khas mi len ba ci yin zer ba gcig byung gsungs/ yang nub gcig gi gtor gong gi dus su/ dpal lha mo 'khor dang bcas pas phyag na za 'og gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin nas 'chams pa gcig byung*/ rong po yang dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug gsung*/ yang nub gcig gi dus na sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku grangs med pa sprin spung ltar du gtibs nas/ sprul skus 'gro don mdzad pa la/ rtsol sgrub ci yang med gsung ba gcig byung*/ 'phrin las shugs las 'byung ba'i brdar snang gsungs/ yang gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa gsal ba las/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi pho brang la sogs pa phyogs med du gsal ba gcig byung gsungs/ rang cag gi tshe rabs mang po'i skye ba'i gnas dang*/ 'chi ba'i mal dang*/ gzhan don dang 'phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i shul dang*/ gnas sa dang rten dang bu slob kyi brgyud pa mang po yod pa 'dra ba shes rgyu gcig byung gsungs/ yang glang lo'i tshes gcig gi dus su/ bod khams kyi brtan ma 'dzam gling gi skyong mas dbu byas nas gzhi bdag rnams 'dus zin nas/ khyed khams su ma bzhud khyed ci gsung nged kyis bsgrub pa yin zer ba gcig byung ba la/ nged thang cig khams su 'gro dgos yod pas 'gro ba yin/ nga'i bu slobs dang gdan sa rnams khyed kyis bdag po gyis byas pa la/ thams cad kun kyi phyag 'tshal zhing de ltar bgyi zer ba gcig byung gsungs/ yang mtshur phu nas gtsang la bzhud pa'i dus su/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa la/

dpa' bo dha ki sprin ltar du gtibs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas/ gtsang gi phyogs na yar sprin rlung gis ded pa bzhin thal ba gcig byung*/ de'i don ni/ bstan pa phyogs med du dar ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ snams na phyin ba'i dus su/ gnyan chen po thang lhas gtso bo byas pa'i jo mo gangs kar kha rag dang bod khams kyi brtan ma rnams kyis/ dar dang rin po che sna tshogs bzungs nas/ bar snang gang bas skor ba byed pa gcig byung gsungs/ gnyan chen thang lha 'di sngon du 'ong shing skor ba byed chos nyan bu slob la brtse gdung che bar 'dug gsung*/ mi ma yin pa rnams kyi nang na kha drag par 'dug gsung yar chab rtsangs po'i 'gram du phyin pa'i dus su/ rtsang po rangs pa sbrul 'go zings kyis byas nas/ klu rnams kyis phyag 'tshal ba gcig byung gsungs/ de nas g.yag sde na nub gcig bsdad pa'i nyi ma snga dro gcig la/ nam mkha' 'jas gang ba'i dus su/ jo mo kha rag gis shangs drag tu sbud pa las/ rlung nag gi tshogs su gyur nas yul khams thams cad gang bar 'dug gsungs/ yang 'brong phur phyin pa'i dus su/ gsang ba ye shes kyi dha ki ma la/ 'od zer dmar po zla gam gi dbyibs lta bu gcig spros nas/ gtsang dang yul khams thams cad gang ba cig byung*/ de'i don ni dbus gtsang thams cad dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang 'brong bur rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ rmi lam du rdo rje gtum po phyag na rgyal mtshan bsnams pa gcig la/ 'od zer kha dog rnam pa lnga phyogs bcur 'phro ba gcig byung gsungs/ de'i don 'brong bur rab gnas yags pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang dbu ri mda' ltag lung na dbang bskur mdzad pa'i dus su/ rje btsun ma zhal gcig ma bsam kyi mi khyab pa la/ dha ki ma sde bzhi gar thabs dang skor ba byed pa gcig 'dug /rma bya ras pa la bstan pas gtso mo de mthong ba 'dra gsungs/ dbu rir dbang bskur gcig mdzad pa'i dus su/

rje btsun ma yan lag ma tshang ba dpag tu med pa gcig byung*/ de'i don ni khong rnams dam tshig gis nyams pa yin ba 'dra gsungs/ tshong dus 'gur mo na dang po phyin ba'i dus su/ gzhi bdag lha 'dre thams cad bros nas thal/ dge bsnyen kha'o gangs bzang gis phyag 'tshal nas/ khyed la nged rnams skrags par byung*/ gzi brjid chen po mi bstan bar zhu zer ba gcig byung gsungs/ de nas rtsang btsan brag bar du byon ba'i dus su/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi dha ki ma kha dog sna tshogs pa yod pa/ 'go brnyan sna tshogs yod pa nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin du skad cig tsam gyis byung nas/ do nub dur khrod rnams na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin bas/ khyed kyang gdan 'dren pa yin bas/ khyed sems la dbang thob pa yin bas/ khyed cis kyang 'byon par zhu zer ba gcig byung gsungs/ de'i dus su tar ti ta dang u rgyan dang dpal kyi ri la sogs pa gnas mang por phyin pa dang*/ grub thob mang po dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam kyis mi khyab pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor bskor nas cir yang nus pa rmi lam dang dngos su byung*/ gzhan snang du yang khams mi bde ba la nya se nyo se ba gcig las ma byung ba 'dra gsungs/ yang tshong dus 'gur mo na gdan drangs nas/ phyi skor rab gnas byas pa'i dus su/ slob dpon pad ma dang thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho nam mkha' gang ba tsam du 'dug /de'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' gang ba byung*/ yang mgur mo na pad+ma sa 'gul byas pa'i dus su/ sa yi lha mo brtan mas sa nam mkha' la gtor ba cig byung gsungs/ yang 'gur mor pad ma khro 'gul byas pa'i dus su/ dha ki rgya mtsho gar thabs mdzad pa gcig byung gsungs/ yang kha rag bkra shis tshe ring ma la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi brtan ma bcu gnyis 'ja' tshon lta bu'i gur nang na bzhugs shing*/ gar dang dbyangs dang rol mo sna tshogs byed cing phyag mang po 'tshal ba gcig byung gsungs/

yang bye gling dgon par phyin ba'i dus su// kha bo gangs bzang gyis mi dkar rta dkar can grangs med pas mdung dar dkar po bzung nas bsu ba la byung nas/ khyed kyi zhabs tog nged kyis byed zer zhing dga' nas 'dug /bye gling du de nub dmar gtor chen po gcig btang ba'i dus su/ slob dpon pad ma dang*/ rta mgrin gar mdzad cing hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa gcig byung*/ rma bya na byon ba'i dus su/ dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum la 'khor mkha' 'gro ma nag mo 'bum sprin nag gtibs pa 'dra ba gcig byung*/ de'i don ni rma bya ras pas/ chang zangs lnga tsam 'ongs nas byin rlabs byas nas nam mkha' la gtor ba dang*/ kho dgyes rdor la mos gus che ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ brag thog na byon ba'i dus su/ bla ma don grub pas/ mchod cung gcig zhus pa'i dus su/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dang rje btsun mas nam mkha' gang ba gcig 'dug /de ni don grub bla ma la mos gus che ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ spyi bsdus na byon pa'i dus su/ gtor ma chen po gcig btangs nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro drag tu bskul ba'i dus su/ phyag na rdo rje khyung dang bcas pa gtsang lung pa na mi shong ma gcig gzigs/ yang dbus rir byon ba'i dus su/ gtsang dang mnga' ris kyi lha 'dres bsu skyel byed pa gcig byung gsungs/ yang dbus rir tshad ma mkhan la tshod ma blud pa'i dus su// nga rang yang dpal bhir+ya pa rang yin snyam pa yun ring du byung*/ yang gtor ma chen po gcig btang ba'i dus su/ dpal ma mgon sprin ltar du gtibs pa gcig byung gsungs/ mdung chung na gsol ba bsad pa dang gsad pa gso ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus su/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa rang chags yun ring du gyur pa gcig byung gsungs/ nye gnas seng ge dpal gyis dbang bskur zhus pa'i dus su/ sgrol ma sngon mos nam mkha' gang ba gcig byung gsungs/ yang dbu ri nas rma byar byon ba'i dus su/

shri tsa kra sam bha ras nam mkha' gang ba gcig snang ba las de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur 'phro ba gcig gzigs/ de'i don ni 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang tshong dus su bzhud pa'i dus su/ dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi mchod pa phul ba gcig byung gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin drag pas tshong dus kun byer ba gcig byung*/ de'i dam tshig dang dbang gis dang po tshong dus pas ye ma bltas nas thams cad mkhar la zhugs pa de yin bar snang gsungs/ yang tshur lam jo mo gangs kar zhol du tshur 'ongs pa'i dus su/ gangs dkar mas dbu byas pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ srid pa'i ma mo rnams 'tshogs nas mtshan la phyag 'tshal zhing skor ba byed pa gcig byung gsungs/ khong rnams kyi dngos grub yin ba 'dra bas/ dbyar sgang kha ba pus nub tsam gcig babs gsungs/ yang mtshur phu nas stag lung du 'gro dgos bsam nas/ 'bras skud du phyin pa'i dus su/ khong gis ma 'ongs zer nas tshur byon pa'i dus su/ ye shes pa dang 'jig rten ba rnams khro zhing 'khrugs nas thal ba gcig byung gsungs/ de'i don ni khong la nang 'khrug dang mi legs pa mang po 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug gsung*/ yang rag ma shul na byon pa'i dus su/ dam pa rgya gar gnam gyi skar ma tsam gyi nyams gcig byung*/ yul de dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin bar 'dug gsungs/ yang lo sar dang rgyal nya phrad pa'i dus su/ rgyal ba rigs lnga la byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor ba gcig gzigs/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la gtogs pa 'jig rten yi khams spu tsam yang med par 'dug gsungs/ yang byi ba lo tshes brgyad kyi dus su/ tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul ba snyam pa gcig byung*/ de'i don ni lha'i rtsar rlung sems 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang mtshur phu'i byi ba lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu dgu'i nyin par/

phyag na rdo rje la khro bo bcus bskor ba gcig gzigs pa'i dus su/ phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob cing mthu stobs rnams khro rgyal rnams dang mnyam gdug pa can rnams khyod kyis thul zer ba cig byung gsungs/ de'i don ni 'o skol gar 'dug pa'i sa dang*/ dkyil 'khor dbang bskur dang rab gnas gar byas kyang sa chen po 'dul zhing dgra bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i brdar yin bar 'dug gsungs/ yang tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin par nam mkha' 'jas gang ba'i dus su/ mkha' 'gro ma mang po'i 'od zer yin bar snang gsungs/ yang rong po la mthu byas pa'i dus su/ lha mos nam mkha' gang ba can byung*/ de'i don ni bstan pa dar ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang stod lung mda' na byon ba'i dus su/ mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po bsu ba la yar byon ba la/ 'go brnyan can kyi tshogs bsam kyis mi khyab pa dang*/ dar zabs la sogs pas nam mkha' dang sa gzhi gang ba dang*/ kho 'dug pa'i sa brag ri de rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du bstan pa dang*/ kho klu'i rgyal po dung skyong gi bu yin par 'dug /kho'i 'khor gyis dbus gtsang kham gsum khyab par snang*/ dbus gtsang gi sa cha 'di rnams kyi mi nor thams cad khyed la 'bul zer ba gcig byung gsungs/ de'i phyir dbus gtsang 'dir bstan pa dar ba gcig 'ong gsungs// drug gu sgang du gral dpon la byon ba'i dus su/ dpa' mgon po'i lha dmag kyis snang srid zil gyis mnan pa gcig byung gsungs/ yang yor por bzhud pa'i dus su/ yar chab rtsangs po la sdong gru dor ma nyan ba'i dus su// mkha' 'gro ma mang pos nged kyis gdan drangs zer nas/ nam mkha' la bteg nas phar song nyams snyams byed gsungs/ de'i dus su steng 'og phyogs 'tshams thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin dpung gtibs pa snyam byed gsungs/ gzhan snang du chu la ma reg par 'ja' tshon gyi gur nang na mdung gang tsam kyi nam mkha' la bzhud par mthong*/

la las bu mo mang pos 'ja'i snam bu nam mkha' la brkyangs ba'i thog tu bzhud par mthong*/ slob ma phar kar thon ba rnams kyis/ na bza' la yar then nas chu la spun 'bog byas par mthong*/ phar kar thon nas nye gnas rnams kyis na bza' dang zhabs la bltas pas chu la ma reg par snang gsungs/ de'i dus su rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas bskor ba gcig lho phyogs su yun ring du bzhugs pa gcig byung*/ lho phyogs 'di na yang bstan pa dar nas yong gsungs/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa thod dgal bas 'gro don mdzad bya ba yang yin gsungs/ spyir sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa gsum yod pa las/ thugs kyi sprul pa sa ra ha/ sku'i sprul pa pad ma/ gsung gi sprul pa dam pa rgya gar/ de gsum ngo bo gcig pa yin pa 'dra/ dus gsum mkhyen pa bram ze chen po'i sprul pa yin/ mes srong btsan sgam po thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen rta mgrin yin/ de'i sprul pa pad ma yin/ pad ma'i sprul pa mi ta 'dzo gi yin/ mi ta skye 'chi med pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ lo stong tshun chad dang ding sang phan chad du/ rang cag kyang mi tas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ mi ta'i ting nge 'dzin kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa 'dra/ lar skye ba bcu drug gi bar du/ yi dam thugs rje chen po dang*/ rta mgrin gyi sgo nas/ 'gro ba'i dad dpon bsam kyi mi khyab pa byas pa yin gsungs/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ dmag dpon lta bus 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa byas pa'i don yang de yin gsungs/ ding sang gi dbang du byas na rje mi tas byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'phrin las dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas 'phrin las sna tshogs la thogs pa med pa'i don yang de yin gsungs/ lha mo e ka tsa ti dang*/ ma mo 'di kun yang skye ba bcu drug gi chos skyong yin/

de'i phyi na dngos su sgyug pa'i rgyu yod pa'i don yang de yin gsungs/ yu gur yi yul na rnal 'byor nga dang 'dra ba gcig yod/ bya byed spyod pa nga dang mthun pa gcig yod/ de yis sems can rnams la phan par 'dug gsungs/ bal po dang bod gnyis kyi bar 'tshams na/ rngon pa'i gzugs mda' gzhu thogs pa gcig la bud med gcig kyang yod/ bus med de ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin/ de yang rje mi tas byin gyis brlabs pa gcig yin/ des sems can 'ga' tsam la phan pa yin gsungs/ yo skol dang yang 'brel pa yod gsungs/ khos ngo shes kyang srid gsungs/ yar lung 'dir yang rnal 'byor pa chags lam ba gcig yod/ des yang sems can 'ga' la phan gsungs/ lar snang ba la bden zhen kyi gnas lugs kyi don rtogs nas/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu cir yang sprul nyan pa yin gsungs/ brtul shugs kyi spyod pa la rang dbang thob nas ci bya nyan pa yin bas/ nga'i bu slobs rnams la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba 'ong gsungs/ hor 'di dga' rab dbang phyugs dang gnam the'u sprul pa yin bar 'dug pas/ bstan pa bshig pa la/ ngas sus kyang ma tshor bar gdug pa can rnams btul bas/ gar phyin gar 'dug kyi yul thams cad bde ba dang*/ rgyal khams 'di yang bde ba dang*/ bod khams 'di yang je che 'jam la 'ong shes gsungs/ rgyal khams kun tu 'gro ba'i don yang de yin gsungs/ gzhan yang nga'i gdan sa gar btsugs pa dang*/ chos khri dang dkyil 'khor gar bzhengs pa la sogs pa thams cad yun ring du gnas shing*/ 'gro ba'i don du gyur pa yin/ nga'i bu slobs nang na yang sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bu rgan mang po dang*/ dwags po lha rje'i bu slobs yang 'ga' re yod gsungs/ ༈ nga sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i dus su/ rgyal po gcig tu sku 'khrungs/ rgyal srid 'khor dang bcas pa skyong zhing yod pa la/ dus res shig de dag la skyo ba skyes nas/

sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur/ rgyal 'khor rgyal srid la sogs pa spu tsam yang chags thog med par btangs nas/ thub pa'i drung na rab tu byung bar 'dug /de'i bag chags yis da res yang brgyags phyogs med du 'gyed pa'i don yang de yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes su de nas mes srong btsan sgam po'i dus su/ shar phyogs kyi gling gcig na 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i cha byad can/ rgyal po seng ge rab rtsal bya ba yin snyam ba byung*/ byang lam rkog na yar 'ongs pa'i dus su/ de'i dus kyi rgyal po rang yin snyams/ dmag dpon chen po rang yin snyam ba gcig byung ngo*// hor 'di kun bzlogs na tshegs med snyam pa gcig byung*/ de'i dus su shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dran ba gcig byung*/ de spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gcig yin ba 'dra gsungs/ slob dpon rdo rje shes rab zhes bya ba/ las kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba de dang dus mtshungs par 'dug gsungs/ sku skye ba de rnams su sems can rnams la 'brel pa bzhag pa'i stobs kyis/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris la sogs pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus shing 'phrin las kun 'grub pa'i brda' de yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes su sangs rgyas ye shes rin chen dang*/ slo dpon pad ma'i slob ma yang yin la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs pa gcig yin/ de'i don gyis da lta yang dpal rta mgrin rang yin snyam ba'i 'du shes byung zhing*/ gar phyin ba'i sar gdug pa can 'dul nus te/ mis mi shes gsungs/ slob dpon pad ma'i slob ma ngan lam rgyal mchog dbyangs de dang*/ de min yang de'i dus su gzhan don mdzad pa'i de dang dus mtshungs par 'dug gsung so// sku skye ba de'i rjes la/ sngon gyi dus su/ sku skye ba bzhengs pa'i mtshan dge bsnyen yon tan blo gros bya bar gyur nas/ thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa la bsnyen pa mang po byas pas/

bdag gzhan gyi sgrib pa byang nus pa gcig yin/ de la phyogs pa mang po 'dug ste chog gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes su/ yang 'phags pa klu grub kyi dus su mtshan dge slong shes rab rgyan bya ba gcig tu sku skye ba bzhengs pa'i dus su/ sgrol ma khro gnyer can la bsnyen pa mang du byas pas/ 'phrin las sna tshogs pa bsgrub nus pa gcig yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la/ rgya nag tong kun gyi yul na/ rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor pa gcig tu sku skye ba bzhengs nas/ lha 'dre mi gsum dam la btags shing mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang dpag tu med pa bzhengs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa drag po'i sgo nas btsugs pa yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes su/ de nas gnod sbyin lcang lo can bya ba'i bur sku 'khrungs nas/ gnod sbyin rnams la gsang sngags kyi chos mang po bshad pas 'dul ba yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la/ de nas nub ba glang spyod kyi zhing khams na/ rtul shugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ mtshan nyi ma'i 'od zer can zhes bya bar sku skye ba bzhengs nas/ phyi pa mu stegs pa mang du brtul/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byas/ de'i 'phrin las kyi lhag mas ding sang yang bon po dang mu steg pa rnams 'dul sla bar 'dug gsungs/ de dang dus mtshungs nub phyogs de nyid du/ mgon po la dbang bsgyur ba'i sngags pa gcig tu gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba zhig yin gsungs/ mi rnams kyis ma ha ka la rang yin zer ba gcig byung 'dra/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la rgya gar nub phyogs na rnal 'byor seng ghe ye shes spyan bya bar skye ba bzhengs nas/ rtul shugs sna tshogs spyod/ skye bo tha mal pa mang po thabs kyis btul ba yin gsungs/ de dang dus mtshungs par rnal 'byor ma chang 'tshong ma bya bar gyur nas/ snang srid dbang gis 'phrin las kyi rgyal po dang*/

mi rnams smin grol la bkod pa yin/ de dus rnam 'phrul gcig ngo bo cig sa zin pa min gdul byar gyur pa'i mi rnams la rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs su bstan cing 'gro ba'i don phyogs med du/ ding sang gi 'di bzhin du rgyal khams kun tu 'phyos cing*/ smin grol byas pa 'dra gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ pad ma dbang chen grub pa'i gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa chen po gcig tu gyur nas/ yul khams de'i lha 'dre mi gsum gdug pa can rnams 'dul zhing rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa byas/ gar song cha med par nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin du gling kun tu yang rgyu nus pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa 'dra/ de dus mkha' la rgyu ba'i mkha' lding cig gi gzugs brnyan du gyur nas/ klu rnams 'dul ba gcig tu byung ba 'dra gsungs/ de'i stobs kyis ding sang yang klu rnams rang dbang med par 'dul ba yin gsungs/ de dang dus mtshungs par 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid na/ pad ma bod la byon pa'i sngon rol na/ rgyal po dz+wa'i rjes tsam du/ gsang sngags snying ma rang 'chad shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po gcig tu gyur nas/ mtshan ni rdo rje ye shes 'bar ba zhes bya ba yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la me tri pa'i slob ma 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs pa yin gsungs/ de'i dus su yang thun mong gi spyod pa sna tshogs pa byed pa yin gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la/ de nas kha che'i grong khyer trig brtan bya bar sku skye ba bzhengs pa'i dus su/ mtshan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa yon tan rgyal po zhes thogs/ rten ni phyi dge slong du 'dug pa/ nang gsangs sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa ma mgon lcam dral bran du 'khol ba/ rtul shugs spyod pas dregs pa can thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ 'khor du dge slong stong tsam gyis bskor ba gcig yin gsungs// sku skye ba de'i rjes ma shud ke ban rgan rgya mtsho dang 'brel pa yod par 'dug gsungs/

bstan pa srung ba'i ched du byung ba yin gsungs/ de'i don kyi lha mo dang grub thag nye ba'i rgyu de yin gsungs/ la stod dmar por grags pa de dang dus mtshungs pa yin/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i bskyed rdzogs sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsum tsam dang 'brel pa yod pa 'dra gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la/ gshen re thul 'di yin snyam ba byung*/ de'i don ni slobs dpon pad ma'i 'phrin las kyi sprul pas/ khams kyi lha 'dre rnams 'dul bar 'dug /skye ba mang rab kyi dus su/ zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la dbang thob rtul shugs kyi spyod pa dpag tu med pa spyod cing skye ba re re la yang sems can gyis mthong lugs bsam kyis mi khyab pa dang rnam 'phrul grangs med pas gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba yin gsungs/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi slob ma gsang sngags rdo rje rgyal po bya ba bskyed rdzogs la dbang thob pa gcig yin snyam pa byung*/ rdzogs chen 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'i cog ro bsgom chen 'di dang 'brel ba yod/ de'i don gyi da lta yang rdzogs pa chen po'i chos thams cad phyogs med du rtogs pa dang*/ shes par byung gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i rjes la ras cung ba dang 'brel pa yod pa 'dra/ ras chung ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ rlung sems kyi gdams ngag zab mo 'di rnams rang bzhin gyis shes pa sems la shar shing byung gsungs/ bram ze chen po dang*/ me tri pa dang*/ te'u pu ba dang*/ da lta yang*/ yang dang yang du mjal ba de/ sngon kyi 'brel pa yod par 'dug /bsre ba'i gdams ngag 'di rnams bram ze chen pos brdas bstan nas/ me tri pa dang te'u pu bas dag snang du gsungs pa yin/ sngon chad na ro pa'i brgyud pa la med pa yin gsungs/ kham pa lung pa de dang 'brel pa yod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thugs rje chen pos 'gro don dpag tu med pa byas/ 'phan yul ba dang dbu ru stod du phyin ba'i dus su shes rgyu gcig byung gsungs/

rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa pad ma dbang phyug dang*/ de gsum ngo bo gcig yin gsungs// sku skye ba de'i rjes la/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa bhud dha bod de bya ba yin gsungs/ grub rtags mang po 'don cing mu stegs pa mang po btul nas/ 'gro ba mang po skye ba med pa'i don la bkod pa yin/ da res zhal gtsom drag po yod pa de/ gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i bag chags yin pa 'dra gsungs// sku skye ba de'i rjes la bal po'i rnal 'byor pa mtshan bha shi la bya ba gcig tu skye ba bzhengs pa 'dra gsungs/ sku skye ba de'i gong ma la rnal 'byor yi dbang phyug nyag se lags/ da res sbungs ri na phyin pa'i dus shes rgyu gcig byung gsungs/ sngar gyi bag chags kyis sbungs ri na bsdad cing spyod pa sna tshogs byed pa dang*/ de rnams yang dar zhing rgyas pa yang sngar gyi bag chags yin ba 'dra gsungs/ yang sngar gyi spyod pa'i 'phro yod pa'i phyir/ da ltar yang spyod pa tsam tsom byed 'dod pa dang*/ tho co sna tshogs kyis btsan thabs su phan gnod kyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa de sngon kyi 'phro yod pa yin gsungs/ chos nyid rtsal rdzogs ye shes rnam 'phrul gyis// rgyal sras spyod pas dus gsum 'gro ba 'dren// rtag tu 'gro skyobs rje btsun la btud nas/ de nyid gsung bzhin ma 'ongs mdzad spyod bri// bla ma rin po che'i sku skye ba de'i phyi ma la/ dus gcig sprul pa 'gas 'gro don mdzad pa 'dra gsungs/ yang shar phyogs kyi zhing 'khams bkod pa mtha' yas pa/ rin po che bkod pa zhes bya ba na/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mtshan pad ma'i rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba cig 'byung*/ lo grangs med par byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod par 'ong*/ de dang dus mtshungs par sprul pa gcig dga' ldan du/ mgon po byams pa'i drung na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par 'ong*/ lha'i lo khri phrag tsam thub/

'brel pa yod tshad der drongs par 'dug gsung*/ byams pa'i bstan pa la skye ba nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam gyi bar du/ byams pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byed pa yin gsungs/ da lo brgya tsam na/ bram ze chen po'i thugs kyi sprul pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sprul pa'am/ ngo bo'am rnam 'phrul cig byon nas bstan pa skyong yang shes/ dus tshod mar 'grib dus su song ba'i phyir/ ding sang yi phrin las tsam gyi 'byung bar ran tsam 'byung*/ 'di rnams kyi bu slobs/ slob dpon pad ma la thug pa yin gsungs/ ding sang yang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi/ lha 'dre thams cad kyang nga'i bu slobs yin pa'i phyir/ bu slobs rnams kyi brgyud pa zin na/ lha 'dre rnams kyis brgyud pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa yin gsungs/ da res yang ting nge 'dzin gar gtad gtad du/ 'phrin las rnams bzhi dang*/ grub rtags sna tshogs 'byung bar 'dug gsungs/ 'dren pa 'dar ma 'gu ru'i/ rnam thar zabs don bka' rgya ma/ chos rje'i yon tan rab mthong nas// mun par sgron me bteg pa bzhin// mnyam med ras pa chen po'i sa// zhus shing bkod pa'i dge ba des// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// gnyis med mun pa rab bsal nas// gnyis med ye shes rabs rgyas shog /dad pa can kyis mos gsol shin// yon tan spel bar bya ba'i phyir// bla ma rin po che'i rnam thar yi ger bkod// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// rnam thar zabs don bka' rgya ma/ gtad rgya/ gsang rgya/ bka' rgya// / zhus so/// /gar ma tobs ldan rnam thar 'di// gar bzhug mthong thos sems can rnams// gar skye gar gnas thams cad du// gar po dge la spyod par shog// /
